summary: This is a locked Freakz forum thread from January 2019 in which TheOgopogo asks for a BIS (best-in-slot) list for the Vengeance Demon Hunter spec for patch 7.1.5 of World of Warcraft. DoesMyNameMatter replies with advice on set bonuses, legendaries, stat priorities, relics and trinkets, but admits the reply is not a clear BIS list and offers to write one. The page's boilerplate (navigation, login forms, language flags) is ignored.
one_line: A 2019 Freakz forum thread asking for and giving advice on best-in-slot gear and stats for Vengeance Demon Hunters in WoW patch 7.1.5.
key_facts: The forum thread is titled 7.1.5 BIS Vengeance DH? and sits in the Trash Bin section of the Freakz forum, where it is locked.
TheOgopogo posted the original question on 11-01-2019, asking for a BIS list for Vengeance Demon Hunter for the 7.1.5 list.
DoesMyNameMatter replied on 16-01-2019 with guidance on what Vengeance players should aim for.
The reply says players should first get the 2 set bonus from Tomb of Sargeras (ToS) as soon as possible.
The reply says the Nighthold set and the 4-piece Tomb set are not really needed because they are tied to Soul Cleave, which is almost never used.
The reply says Vengeance legendaries are really good overall and no single one is incredibly better than the others.
The reply says many legendary sets include Prydaz, mainly for its stats and because its effect is really good on tanks.
The reply says the cloak, legs, boots and Archimonde Trinket are usually the best items, while the leech and talent rings are pretty terrible.
The reply recommends 10-15% versatility for general purposes, which can drop to maybe 7-9% if item level is low.
The reply says relics should aim for Immolation Aura damage and/or Fire damage versus Fiery Branded targets.
The reply warns that the Metamorphosis duration relic trait is bugged on Freakz because it does not increase the timer of the Golden Trait Proc Fueled By Pain.
The reply names Unstable Arcanocrystal and Shivermaw's Jawbone as the two really good trinkets, with Shivermaw's Jawbone obtainable mainly by donation from Assault on Violet Hold.
The reply names Majordomo's Dinner Bell from Return to Karazhan as another hard-to-get decent trinket.
The reply says the author did not fully answer the question because no clear BiS list was given, and offers to provide one.
